vegetables.name: Tomato
vegetables.storage_tip: Keep ripe tomatoes at room temperature; refrigerate when very ripe.

vegetables.name: Potato
vegetables.storage_tip: Store cool, dark and dry; keep away from onions.

vegetables.name: Onion
vegetables.storage_tip: Store whole onions in a cool, dry, ventilated place.

vegetables.name: Carrot
vegetables.storage_tip: Refrigerate in a produce bag; remove leafy tops.

vegetables.name: Spinach
vegetables.storage_tip: Refrigerate dry in a breathable container.

vegetables.name: Broccoli
vegetables.storage_tip: Refrigerate unwashed in a loose bag.

vegetables.name: Cabbage
vegetables.storage_tip: Keep whole and refrigerated until cut.

vegetables.name: Cauliflower
vegetables.storage_tip: Refrigerate in a loose bag, stem side down.

vegetables.name: Cucumber
vegetables.storage_tip: Keep dry and refrigerated away from very cold spots.

vegetables.name: Brinjal
vegetables.storage_tip: Use soon; refrigerate if your kitchen is warm.
